purpose: Regression guard for a blockedSince that may never ship. S0-T1 measured no defensible stable entry clock on the hook contract, so absence is the expected wire state. IF a stable entry clock is ever added, a session that stays in needsInput while the hook record's updatedAt advances must not reset dead time — any age drop across passes fails this fixture. It does not require blockedSince or standbyMs on today's wire.
claim: A heartbeat cannot reset dead time. If blockedSince exists, it is the instant the session entered its current person-blocked state — stable across collector passes and across a server bounce. It is never updatedAt, and never 0.
wireExpectation: blockedSince may be permanently absent; this fixture is inert until a stable entry clock lands

passes.name: pass-2 heartbeat sixty seconds later — same needsInput
pass-3 another heartbeat — age only grows

antiCases.name: deriving blockedSince from updatedAt on every pass
antiCases.claim: If a future blockedSince tracks the heartbeat write time, deadTime collapses toward zero each pass. That is the defect this guard exists to catch — only if the field lands.
